name: Trade
definition: Result of an order between at least two parties. A trade relates to the delivery of goods and services, cash or securities.

TradeDateTime.name: Trade Date Time
TradeDateTime.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date on which the trade is settled, ie, the amounts are due.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: End date of the trade, such as a treasury trade or a derivative trade.

AllocationIndicator.name: Allocation Indicator
AllocationIndicator.definition: Specifies the type of allocation for a trade.

BlockIndicator.name: Block Indicator
BlockIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the trade is a block or single trade.

SettlementNetting.name: Settlement Netting
SettlementNetting.definition: Indicates to the clearing member whether the trade is eligible for settlement netting or not.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date of the trade, such as a treasury trade or a derivative trade.

TradeCommission.name: Trade Commission
TradeCommission.definition: Commission parameters associated with a trade.

TradeRelatedIdentifications.name: Trade Related Identifications
TradeRelatedIdentifications.definition: Specifies the different identifications associated with a trade.

TradePartyRole.name: Trade Party Role
TradePartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in relation with a trade.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Specifies the trade which originates the obligation to deliver a product, cash or securities..

RelatedNegotiation.name: Related Negotiation
RelatedNegotiation.definition: Negotiation process which is the source of the treasury trade.

GoverningDocument.name: Governing Document
GoverningDocument.definition: Legal agreement applicable to a trade.

System.name: System
System.definition: System involved in the processing of a trade such as clearing, settlement or matching system.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Asset which is the object of a trade.

Market.name: Market
Market.definition: Market where a trade is negotiated and executed.

Order.name: Order
Order.definition: Specifies the order related to a trade.

Leg.name: Leg
Leg.definition: Separate transactions which combined together form a trade.

FinancialTransaction.name: Financial Transaction
FinancialTransaction.definition: Financial transaction to which the trade belongs.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Process which compares and matches trade information with entries in an account.
